FeedstockFunction.description: This enumeration indicates the function of a specific feedstock.

Undefined.description: The function of the feedstock is unknown.

Main.description: The feedstock is used for production and is part of the finished part.

Ancillary.description: The feedstock is used for production but removed before the part is finished.

Consumable.description: The feedstock is consumed during the production e.g., process gas.
